_comment: Issue #91 (hour-4 spine): riverfarm_thicket_patch's confirm conversation -- the crab_nest informed-consent shape applied to Riverfarm's first respawns:true renewable-cull slot. Run by the riverfarm_village `riverfarm_thicket_patch` encounter's `conversation` field (interact.encounter branch fires dialogue BEFORE combat). [Strike first.] ends the conversation and fires `start_combat: riverfarm_thicket_patch` (self-reference; legal ONLY on an ending option). [Back away.] plainly ends -- no combat, the encounter stays live and re-interactable. TRAP (dormant re-interact): respawns:true, so a same-waking re-interact after a victory falls to start_combat's dormant refusal (DIALOGUE_EFFECT_FAILED, no crash) -- the next sleep re-arms it. No requires/hide_when on any option.

confront.speaker: The Creeping Thicket
confront.text: The vines shift again, closer this time, thorns catching the light like drawn wire. Whatever Eloise's craft left in them, it never quite went back to sleep.
